title: C1-02 state-conditioned pair typed-array record contract
null_encoding: NPZ q_target uses all-six NaN sentinel iff label_present=false; teacher_selected_distance uses NaN iff no teacher selection (missing label or local). No other NaN/Inf allowed. Validator never exposes sentinels to input features. JSON audit represents missing values as null.
cross_field_rules: source group/split/root q must match independently verified F0-04 row before derivation
one local and one wide pair per root; both inherit root group/split/source family
pair_id and candidate_family derive from source_sample_id plus pair_mode; no split-dependent reseeding
local: label_present=true, q_target=root_q_target, teacher_status=NOT_APPLICABLE, teacher counts=0
wide: teacher_status VALID iff label_present and selected ordinal in [0,3]; FAILED iff missing label and ordinal=-1
q_target and selected_distance NaN sentinels permitted only for declared missing/not-applicable cases
model input projection is exactly position_m, quaternion_wxyz, q_current
